Combined the core dine-in 'Menu' (Small Plates/Insalata/Pasta/Entrees/Pizza Rossa/Pizza Bianca) with Weekly Specials, Lunch Specials and Dessert Menu sub-menus, each prefixed by its own menu name. Dropped 'Catering Menu' (per-person banquet pricing plus rental line items - Chairs/Linen/Overlays/Chair Sashes) and 'Alla Cart Party Trays' (per-lb/per-tray/per-dozen bulk pricing) as catering/adjunct, not dine-in prices. Price level matches Yelp/Instagram/UberEats reports of similar-range Italian pricing at this address.

name: Cori Pastificio Trattoria
blocked: needs-browser: own site (coripasta.com/menu, Squarespace) publishes no prices at all - text says 'menu updates every week, please call or ask a server'. Grubhub listing shows real prices in Google's snippet (Arancini $19.00, Meatballs $18.00, Octopus $25.20) but the page itself is a pure client-rendered shell (13.6KB, no ld+json, no server data) that curl cannot extract, and Grubhub/Seamless is a single tier-5-equivalent source anyway. No DoorDash/UberEats listing found via search.

name: Manna Heaven BBQ Downtown
blocked: core-unpriced: this is an all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ house with two flat per-person packages (A2 $30.99/person, A1 Premium $37.99/person), each listing all 58 core BBQ/banchan items with NO individual prices - matches the Hanu Korean BBQ precedent exactly (flat-rate AYCE core, unpriced). The site's separate Beverages/Dessert menu (mannaheavenbbq.com/menu-drinks-2, embedded image) IS itemized and priced (soju, beer, sake, sodas, wine by glass/bottle, one Macaron dessert at $3.99), but per rule 4 these are adjuncts, not the core dine-in offering, so filing them alone would misrepresent this as a drinks/dessert-only spot. Checked both AYCE package pages (ayce-kbbq-menu-1-2, ayce-kbbq-menu-2-1-1) plus the drinks page; no other menu pages exist on the site.
